title: The Orange Inn in Goshen and his band
summary: He leads a group with Hal Austin at the Orange Inn in Goshen, with a tenor and clarinet player he schools and an upscale crowd.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: : So now, this place you're playing in Orange, in New York, near where, did you say?
That's in the Goshen, out there where they have the racetrack, the Hall of Fame ______.
: Who do you have in your group there?
Have Hal Austin, who was with ______ Jones and Kelly ______ on organ and I have ______, a Jewish boy that was up there with Frank Williams. He's turned into a monster on his horn now, you see.

on tenor, see, but what's happening (inaudible) this year. (Inaudible) with Frank and those people, they didn't give him a chance (inaudible). But out here, we school him and he's got his tape recorder and if he have to play a solo (inaudible), he play it. He can write anything and he play all the way anything Hirshel play, he play it all the way. He got the tones and he can play anything Stan Getz, any guy, so now he's up on his instrument. Then he copies me in solo work. A lot of things I do, he do it, too. So he gets down (inaudible). It's one of them things like Duke, you never know what's happening next in the band.
What's the name of the place?
The Orange Inn, Goshen, New York.
How many people does it seat?

Oh, I don't know. About -- I think they can seat -- I don't know if they can seat 200 or not, but I'm going to check that out tomorrow because the lady's got -- got a big dining room. That seats a lot of people. But that's another section, but it's a glass there. You can open up the curtain, you can see the band there and the band is halfway -- the bar got a big opening. So when you play, (inaudible) see you in two rooms, seating capacity.

See, they crowd them in where (inaudible) standing room and that's bad, because they got the best class people in here. Most of the people coming there are the best class people, money people. We get the D.A. in there all the time, Mayor of the town, and most all organizations come there like the bank set-up and jewelry. Got a lot of courts going, about five jewelry ________ going on there everyday in the courts. They all ________ nights.
